skill.summary: 提供公路、铁路、水运交通运输工程造价咨询服务的预算编制、费率计算和工作分类指导。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release aligning with Guangdong T/GDHS 017—2026 standard for transport engineering cost consulting:

- Provides classification and definition of consulting service types and specialties (highway, railway, waterway).
- Details core budget calculation methods and fee coefficient systems.
- Lists typical work breakdown and recommended budget ratios for common consulting phases.
- Specifies compliance requirements and risk control measures for professional practice.
- Includes coefficient quick-reference tables and checklists for quality and compliance.
- Organizes main and supporting documentation for user guidance and case reference.
